subject: We’ve all got a part to play
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, **[www
body:
I wanted to reach out personally today. | |
---

subject: Let's talk about maternal health

body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250 [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Attacks on reproductive health care have been in the news a lot lately, folks.
But there's one aspect that I feel gets lost in a lot of conversations around reproductive care: Black maternal health. What researchers have found is too egregious to ignore.
In nearly every category, Black mothers are disproportionately impacted by insufficient access to maternal care. Studies show that Black women are three times as likely to die from pregnancy-related complications as white women.
Maternal mortality rates continue to climb exponentially for Black women and women of color, and we cannot continue to turn a blind eye towards it. This is not a problem that will fix itself – it will take investment in communities of color.
As a mother myself, and now, a first-time grandmother, I’ve seen personally the difficult health care experiences that Black women face all too often when pregnant. That’s why I've spent my career advocating for these issues as a proud member of the Black Maternal Health Caucus and the House Health Subcommittee.
In the Senate, I'll work hard to improve maternal health for women across the board and ensure that under-resourced communities have a voice that advocates for maternal health. I'm ready to get to work, but we know this race won't be easy – that's why I need your support.
Will you split any amount between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's? Issues like maternal health are on the line, and I'm ready to be the champion that fights for it [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=10]

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfklbjk7ueod1t42774rqpe9e7ph9eitntu2n1vo_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cji66o36cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z609u5hucnl360f0ic1kgodqs48je0conqvtas4g_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cji66o36cth2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcq7bibhc927hr6mu2le6kubn92ef221bee14mg0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cji66o36cth2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfpda7r80u1182p5lvt2ls4mn4i89j8kndu5krrg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cji66o36cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9ppen585ttv6p40bp8169hddfe94fe8b0jujuug_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cji66o36cjh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl7buul9r714ki6r791s2d309gaelfqnv8d516pg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cji66o36cjh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Congressman Paul Broun
subject: Sign the petition to ban transgender child mutilation
body:
Ban Child Mutilation Nationwide

Dear Concerned American,

Should so-called doctors be
allowed to sexually mutilate or chemically sterilize children -
even children as young as 8 years for girls and 10 years for
boys?

Should publicly-funded schools be
permitted to promote this radical trans-sexual abuse often behind
the backs of parents?

I hope you say ABSOLUTELY NOT!

Yet it is happening every day in
America. In fact, an insider report from a horrified worker at a
Missouri Children's Hospital revealed that the number of children
sent for "gender transition" has increased by more than 400% in
the last five years.

That's why I'm emailing you today
asking you to sign your petition to your U.S. Representative and
Senators demanding they take immediate action to ban the
transgender child sexual mutilation and chemical castration
procedures.

I am former U.S. Congressman Paul
Broun, and I'm more determined than ever to stop the worldwide
tide of Leftism I see targeting our children and grandchildren.

CitizenGO represents millions of
members and supporters fighting back against the radical
anti-family LGBT ideology that has swept through our schools,
media, and entertainment, mercilessly attacking the relationships
between children and their parents and destroying family morality
and faith.

Will you join with millions of
pro-family Citizens to defend our children from transgender child
sexual mutilation?

Click here to sign the petition
to Congress demanding they ban all gender transition procedures
for minors immediately!

Puberty blockers, hormone
supplements, and drastic sexual organ surgery are all procedures
with horrific side effects that children cannot fully grasp. And
in a sea of lies and misinformation, few adults understand the
true horror.

Make no mistake, the transgender
lobby wants them confused and isolated from any dissenting
voices.
*** I've seen an entire
generation of youth come out of their schools confused and
assaulted by the transgender ideology attacking gender and their
sense of self, persuading them to seek poisonous and severely
harmful procedures to change their bodies to "fit in" with the
transgender world.

*** I've seen families torn to
pieces as the newest generation of children, who are fed radical
transgender values with their cereal, clash with bewildered
parents over a child's so-called" gender identity."

*** In a growing number of
States, children are encouraged to hide their planned mutilations
or chemical castrations from their parents by teachers and
counselors.

*** Meanwhile, the transgender
lobby rabidly shuts down or "cancels" any dissenting voices or
studies on the harmful effects of child sexual mutilation.

*** They even more rabidly
suppress any study of the massive number of children who abandon
gender transition after the fact...

... and are left with bitter
regrets, twisted bodies and awful consequences.
The best way to put a stop to
it all is by passing a flat-out Federal ban on administering
these procedures to minors.

Our children, the most vulnerable
members of our society, are being conned into irreversible
procedures that alter their bodies and lives forever.

This is not a matter of choice or
identity - it's a matter of safety and common sense. Minors are
not equipped with the life experience or emotional maturity to
make such grave, scarring, and often irreversible decisions about
their bodies and their futures.

Sign your petition today
demanding Congress step in and protect our children from
transgender mutilation.

Over 20 states have already
passed bans on transgender child sexual mutilation, though many
are being challenged in court.

But states like California and
New York will not follow suit willingly, and the transgender
lobby is howling for blood at the restrictions being placed on
them.

That's why, once you've signed, I
ask you to chip in with a modest contribution to help CitizenGO
bring other Americans into the fight against child sexual
mutilation. Even a gift of $10 or $25 will be a big boost.

The success of this campaign
relies on the power of Citizens standing together to make our
voices heard, and every extra dollar counts when we're fighting
to counter the transgender lobby's pervasive ideology.

So please, sign your petition,
share, and chip in with a quick $10 or $25 contribution to help
CitizenGO recruit more signers and win the fight.

In addition to recruiting more
petition signers to increase the impact of our campaign, your
contribution will help fund:

Hard-hitting advertisements
to highlight and draw attention to the horrible practices of
transgender centers.
Targeted petition deliveries
to key elected officials demanding they take action to defend
children.
Phone calls to likely
supporters to raise awareness and recruit new members.
Radio and TV ads exposing
everything the transgender ideology is inflicting on our
children, should funds permit.

So once you have signed, I
ask that you make a contribution of $10 or $25 to CitizenGO, or
perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or $100, to help expand
their recruitment and to fund all of these plans in CitizenGO's
fight to stop child sexual mutilation.

So please sign your petition,
share, and chip in with a generous contribution of $10 or $25, or
perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or $100 today.

Thank you for standing with us in
this crucial fight for our children's future.

Sincerely,

Paul C. Broun (MD)
U.S. Congressman Georgia 10 Ret.

P.S. I'm more determined than
ever to stop the worldwide tide of Leftism I see targeting our
children and grandchildren.

CitizenGO represents millions of
members and supporters fighting back against the radical
anti-family LGBT ideology, and I want every pro-sanity American
to band together to put a stop to child sexual mutilation and
chemical castration.

The best way to do that is with a
Federal ban on performing Transgender procedures on minors, and
CitizenGO is launching a campaign to do just that. But it will
take people power to succeed.

That's why I'm counting on you to
sign your petition, and then go on to add a modest $10 or $25
contribution, or perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or
$100, to help CitizenGO fight to ban child sexual mutilation.

In addition to signing your
petition and donating, I need you to share it with your friends
and family who share our values so they can have the opportunity
to sign as well. CitizenGO's petition page makes it super easy to
share in a way you prefer.

CitizenGO is a
community of active citizens that works to ensure that human
life, the family and our freedoms are respected worldwide.
CitizenGO members live in every nation of the world. Our team is
spread across 16 countries on 5 continents and operates in 12
languages. Learn about CitizenGO here or follow us on Facebook or
Twitter.

Not produced or
emailed at taxpayer expense.

Friend,

history")** for his second term...

That _every single immigrant who illegally entered our country_ will have to go back...

That **[thousands of deportations will begin on inauguration day,](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32947%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ggsQKNgGAPQhwdVPmrfpBw&sysid=1 "That thousands of deportations

name: Hillsdale College via Freedom Liberty Report
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkb2OnTAQhZ_GdEb-A0xBgcRS3d1E2SKl5cUD11f-k20S7dtHJHv7tHNmzsw35-eretXW2XC8aQ_T7rLKRQWt7tY5bOIDF-1wObNihAlMBKZM8cZMhI5GiAYmOlA2Ui4pbe5TB7skIMe967tOA2XDLuHjauiGkUjZ2OnyIYIyMoiBy3aEsRP9sGtmJEA_IkG0g1zbPQOY6HUwzn5Arp8ZUsy13aJv3HSvNRXEZ8RWxFaX2uveYrSDFsyJ2Gog6Vw9hIrjjh9nqXaDC-QXfF5DfC0b4guhRJA3wgS7kXn5try8vCPWn9WrEs-8AeJLyrEk2KoNx5fkwdjTI76A19Z9FTftk7ZHQHwx8fFc9E-KoUKoiC_v8019n_F6-4Gff2jyZNJv65wt_YAEOS7Pv5T1f-P4EwAA___9vpEm) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkb2OnTAQhZ_GdEb-A0xBgcRS3d1E2SKl5cUD11f-k20S7dtHJHv7tHNmzsw35-eretXW2XC8aQ_T7rLKRQWt7tY5bOIDF-1wObNihAlMBKZM8cZMhI5GiAYmOlA2Ui4pbe5TB7skIMe967tOA2XDLuHjauiGkUjZ2OnyIYIyMoiBy3aEsRP9sGtmJEA_IkG0g1zbPQOY6HUwzn5Arp8ZUsy13aJv3HSvNRXEZ8RWxFaX2uveYrSDFsyJ2Gog6Vw9hIrjjh9nqXaDC-QXfF5DfC0b4guhRJA3wgS7kXn5try8vCPWn9WrEs-8AeJLyrEk2KoNx5fkwdjTI76A19Z9FTftk7ZHQHwx8fFc9E-KoUKoiC_v8019n_F6-4Gff2jyZNJv65wt_YAEOS7Pv5T1f-P4EwAA___9vpEm)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkb2OnTAQhZ_GdEb-A0xBgcRS3d1E2SKl5cUD11f-k20S7dtHJHv7tHNmzsw35-eretXW2XC8aQ_T7rLKRQWt7tY5bOIDF-1wObNihAlMBKZM8cZMhI5GiAYmOlA2Ui4pbe5TB7skIMe967tOA2XDLuHjauiGkUjZ2OnyIYIyMoiBy3aEsRP9sGtmJEA_IkG0g1zbPQOY6HUwzn5Arp8ZUsy13aJv3HSvNRXEZ8RWxFaX2uveYrSDFsyJ2Gog6Vw9hIrjjh9nqXaDC-QXfF5DfC0b4guhRJA3wgS7kXn5try8vCPWn9WrEs-8AeJLyrEk2KoNx5fkwdjTI76A19Z9FTftk7ZHQHwx8fFc9E-KoUKoiC_v8019n_F6-4Gff2jyZNJv65wt_YAEOS7Pv5T1f-P4EwAA___9vpEm)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: The Declaration of Independence argues that the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights and that just government is founded on the consent of the governed. Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat. A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: Kari Lake & Kamala Harris are teaming up!?
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I know you’ve heard how the Arizona Supreme Court made a HUGE decision a few days ago that upheld the state’s Abortion Prevention Law, which was on the books until _Roe v. Wade_ in 1973.

Because of this decision, **ALL ELECTIVE ABORTIONS** in Arizona will now be stopped, saving thousands, if not tens of thousands, of preborn lives.

While this kind of news would typically have me overjoyed because of how many innocent lives would be saved . . . **_I can’t help but be _FURIOUS_!_**

_Why???_ Because two things have happened since this decision was made:

**1._Some Republicans have responded by stabbing us in the back_** , calling for this pro-life victory to be reversed!
U.S. Senate candidate Kari Lake even said that she “opposes the ruling” and called on Gov. Katie Hobbs _(a radical pro-abortion Democrat)_ to come up with a “solution.”
At the Arizona Statehouse, I can name at least one Republican, _and I believe there may be more,_ who is working with Democrats to introduce a pass a law next week to nullify the Abortion Prevention Law.
**2._Vice President Kamala Harris is heading to Tucson, Arizona TOMORROW_** to speak and rally pro-abortion support for an extreme, late-term, no-holds-barred abortion law! And it’s all thanks to Kari _“Two-Face”_ Lake and other Republican’s pathetic response.
This is why _Students for Life Action_ is sending in an immediate response team to Arizona to protest Vice President Harris’ speech, call out the cowardly responses from some Republicans, and demand that the slim GOP majority in the Arizona legislature stand strong, and stop a law from being passed next week in Phoenix that will wipe out the state’s Abortion Prevention Law.

Our students are as OUTRAGED as you and I are – and ready to fight back.

But with all this happening **TOMORROW,** we need to raise the funds to get our Arizona students mobilized as quickly as possible!

**[So, would you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, or $50 to _Students for Life Action’s_ Rapid Response Team so we can fight to keep Arizona’s Abortion Prevention Law on the books](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sukjukl-duchtdja-y/)?**

**[Even just $25 or $10 would help pay for gas or meals for our students](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sukjukl-duchtdja-j/).**

Pro-Life Friend, this Arizona Supreme Court decision should have been celebrated by Republicans everywhere, as it would stand to be the most impactful pro-life victory in the state’s history!

_But what do we get from Republicans instead?_

Either crickets or some traitors who are actually trying to dismantle a life-saving pro-life law and cheerleading for pro-abortion referendums!

If only we could rely on our elected officials to do what’s right, then _Students for Life Action_ wouldn’t be needed . . .

But we can’t rely on them, Pro-Life Friend.

**WE THE PEOPLE** still rule this country.

So, you and I have to be the ones who put pressure on our politicians – _especially Republicans_ – to be unapologetically pro-life.

If we don’t, they’ll run and hide like the cowards they’re proving themselves to be.

You and I have to be the ones who show up at Vice President Harris’ speech and make her recognize the size and power of the Pro-Life Movement.

And right now, it’s the unfailing support of pro-lifers like you and I that our rapid response team needs to hold the line in Arizona.

**[So, will you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to _Students for Life Action’s_ Rapid Response Team](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sukjukl-duchtdja-i/)?**

body:
I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a40f1bb49824a3ca7c1e2b94bfe3c20&_e=PLXpHSCDdwEeaSo9ACDl-BvTZOEHpAOjOEa4jAXt1Nxhw3zteRgPDZE9mY-zEUqUki4g0v6B3Hm5U7X1X8244pJBMq00JY0UYNa6WAuOE0WgmncwwFa-uCWk8rxPtprn8iRB8gTydpcpJyGlMfHecXcfwrlVhYoiEdz1gqHBIlfWJABilqzXn4VyaV41uniHp5wW1icrqQHCaWFALmvjJtMZIATKP_L_g5HrBo2JDtCiwxqu9GrUVO9Fy5kaGLxeMEIoZyJ-iSHnYGHBRtoQGWjILm2DrPqLjcT9MO4NUMSzW8mP-F2LeTEcL0ke_5vUXGzcUerMJab1o3xF1nv7HrnphjZxUyjCP9qdCCr3hx1RA_4pbYpwO5FzLeqKYYul)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a40f1bb49824a3ca7c1e2b94bfe3c20&_e=PLXpHSCDdwEeaSo9ACDl-BvTZOEHpAOjOEa4jAXt1Nxhw3zteRgPDZE9mY-zEUqUki4g0v6B3Hm5U7X1X8244pJBMq00JY0UYNa6WAuOE0WgmncwwFa-uCWk8rxPtprn8iRB8gTydpcpJyGlMfHecXcfwrlVhYoiEdz1gqHBIlfWJABilqzXn4VyaV41uniHp5wW1icrqQHCaWFALmvjJg1HvxvX2dSlF167bYRMLuRFIkOe2idmbxZ22auIgCL6eDo7UoB8LG60pz0hhzhGQhZb4SYwoBC8oMOq_y0Xi9Hm053KXiBYSAt86KeAT8AiToh3ryyJfvzH7kgXCN1Q_rXRHSK3RVT0fK9xbOC_1MIbKb6X369ARVyMMWBd3bNZ)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a40f1bb49824a3ca7c1e2b94bfe3c20&_e=PLXpHSCDdwEeaSo9ACDl-BvTZOEHpAOjOEa4jAXt1Nxhw3zteRgPDZE9mY-zEUqUki4g0v6B3Hm5U7X1X8244pJBMq00JY0UYNa6WAuOE0WgmncwwFa-uCWk8rxPtprn8iRB8gTydpcpJyGlMfHecXcfwrlVhYoiEdz1gqHBIlfWJABilqzXn4VyaV41uniHp5wW1icrqQHCaWFALmvjJsCXJJnJNKsj94KeohfsAWLqjyEj-Wxew0xa0AucraNKzBZJCG3atHQFiV5lHyQtqq4AoDvWic8oA7rnymRsSedl4hw07RL_vQ-YqFOupUH9IzxTYDfMnNC3w2RL5xOHlD4miRfq7_qO3mTonfH4upUqlbrQYeo6GIuzjFwthVtJ)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a40f1bb49824a3ca7c1e2b94bfe3c20&_e=PLXpHSCDdwEeaSo9ACDl-BvTZOEHpAOjOEa4jAXt1Nxhw3zteRgPDZE9mY-zEUqUki4g0v6B3Hm5U7X1X8244pJBMq00JY0UYNa6WAuOE0WgmncwwFa-uCWk8rxPtprn8iRB8gTydpcpJyGlMfHecXcfwrlVhYoiEdz1gqHBIlfWJABilqzXn4VyaV41uniHp5wW1icrqQHCaWFALmvjJiovPq6e8NeRH6EmcOEeQVxlY8xh8rX4OiuhUFphA37OuQDQLUh7h2kdFJH7oEyrXGMZzS3zhc9cIFlW6n7wp8X0hgrQDLg6BtUeWwngY6Tyl602bqS-bhLMdDr_8o2mfLbk0yhmV3XiShX-vxUpdNAok7Ewail_qt8XaqPb97ii)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a40f1bb49824a3ca7c1e2b94bfe3c20&_e=PLXpHSCDdwEeaSo9ACDl-BvTZOEHpAOjOEa4jAXt1Nxhw3zteRgPDZE9mY-zEUqUki4g0v6B3Hm5U7X1X8244pJBMq00JY0UYNa6WAuOE0WgmncwwFa-uCWk8rxPtprn8iRB8gTydpcpJyGlMfHecXcfwrlVhYoiEdz1gqHBIlfWJABilqzXn4VyaV41uniHp5wW1icrqQHCaWFALmvjJll7zo2VjnfjFwCaqYo6z1VYeOFsUw1qmAFQOAMPDjHyL0Y3_kA9FWEN3PNCNvf_vKoXKwLjhP_h8Gj15V2xGUhk813Y70zC8TBkgMyW_hb8_3TvcYIvITALHB4E6UixJc5-jFZLYIR3qRm304ghrdDieTmkgwq29vkSxfTOOKF-)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

clean_body: I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton. Dear Friend, I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton. This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy. I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified. Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder - murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch. The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, I wouldn 't even believe it. - but first, let me explain what happened. Our nightmare started in October of 2020. Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory. Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge. So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter. Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs. My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car. And then it happened. Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car. After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn... Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy. They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist. There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires. Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death. The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with Second-Degree Murder. When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own. He chose to run from the cops. He chose to not wear a helmet. He chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going. So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to sixty years in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began. You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense. The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang... They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before... They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg... And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash. Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence " guilty." He's currently awaiting sentencing. Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear. My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year! And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free... ...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he didn 't do. I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund -or LELDF for short. If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment. Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence. So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone: To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left. If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help. But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now. I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me. Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly. Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive. - Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you. Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today. And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence. Sincerely, Patti Reilly P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart. More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visitwww.PoliceDefense.org. And remember -Blue Lives Matter! body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vPGXJCkB_2NTT7z_Z3Dg9Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn-53gP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQxMlcDc3BjQgpmEEEDGWZgcTE8UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vPGXJCkB_2NTT7z_Z3Dg9Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn-53gP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQxMlcDc3BjQgpmEEEDGWZgcTE8UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vPGXJCkB_2NTT7z_Z3Dg9Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRn-53gP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQxMlcDc3BjQgpmEEEDGWZgcTE8UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

## O.J. Simpson Dead at 76
O.J. Simpson, the former football great [who was accused](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L-O4yAQgPGnwR0WjMd_KChOOrnLNafTlRaBIZkImyyQRHn71W699dd8-v0_bSfHiY_LH7eTbTFvzjd-0oZSgwTcsAs2EgENHVk9azCwGDN3V0tBLZ6GSZtz8IgxKlQeZhe8Ijd607EFBahQgzLjhNDrZXHeqMmgH8npSaCiwC2X_pb5aFeK6Z2fVHqf9y7Za2v3KoZfAlYBqzv7g161v-SvLGD991fAmm-y8n6v-ZAxl52KjDm3s0tJ1uaKdP7jwa1RkPujBCoyMFUBa225vMWwchDDbz0NIyqlumLD_cUpcZ1mgeqyO07fM-1Hms8AAAD__8KRZY0) of and ultimately acquitted of the brutal 1994 slayings of his ex-wife and her friend, has died. He was 76. Simpson, nicknamed "[The Juice](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71u8yAUxvGrwRsWHJ_wMTC8i7e8a0cL40NChCEyNFbvvkrVsdtPeoZH_4_rcvUpp3L773dyPdbFh55etCCXwAEXHDYXiYCmgZzUEiwYa_VwdzEaQGtxVbgGg2HVArxcL5OlTUYrh-RAAAqUIOxFIYzSGB-sUBbDhbxUDAVtqddjfNRU-p1i_qovOsZQ9yG7e-_PxqZ_DGYG83meY1lDobO9dwbzmwzmz8Z_VR-8pf3ZauFbosa14kcoXqKeDAyH255nyjk1pRmK2-5T_nnqf3Z_BwAA___IjVhf)," rose to fame through his accomplishments on the football field as a Heisman Trophy winner and Hall of Famer. After football, Simpson found success as a sportscaster, an actor, and a corporate spokesman, most notably for Hertz rental cars. Simpson's legacy and reputation were [tarnished by his arrest ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vwyAQQH-N2Rwdx_E1MHTJlq4dLYqPmAgby0aJ-u-rdO749Ian93WbbrHUst0_48qh5zbF1MuTJxoljkgTiTlkZmQlOEgr0aPz3oolIBjjnTOgKSuW6GYA45LTyRmrsxUlICABSQSvDeFFOheTB-MpaY7SDAQ8l96Oy6OVrS-c60978nFJbRU1LL3v56A-BrwOeI37xq_zrd5w9JIqD3htj_Es6362bZw59mXUGdlob602jjTRtwJFSTmQ2qaYvDjCvL9KreU0diC4r7HUv2L_9_83AAD__x12V9w)for the 1994 murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman. He was acquitted of charges in what was described as "the trial of the century" but was found responsible for the crimes in a civil trial. He would later serve prison time for armed robbery. As news of his death emerged, many celebrities and associates commented, including former friend Caitlyn Jenner, who posted ["Good Riddance"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskrFu5SwQhZ8Gd74yA9hQuPiV_C5WyrZbWhiGXCLbWDA3bN5-de3dLhWIc4D5zsyvt_nNxjXu7z_thiOFNFtH8RNn2XJoQc6y8WNABBQNjnzgYEAbMzT3sV8AQQvs0C_SczsYI_sOnXZCLEPfNXGEDmQnOXRG9RJuXGvrTNcb6RRa3jPZoY-U8u0jxZ3uGNav9In55tLWrOOd6ChM_MdgYjBRjUSXxmB6sZHWr33-gfuOmcFUyNKjMJj4MGgpNQjJuek0SBiYmDKGuWTHxCvV5wpK_U-hMlDDC1Vnt-M6qoiE24L-r0KYt1P57tnL8p5PgzNukYBWD9a7IJ0QwXi_gLdq0R1XfW-cVNr9-zLt57XCZwb9s7xHXpl4vaBBPbHVE1zBVGu9hfR7x1oufAVTOVKmcm7dlUX7cWbRphAwl3ZZHzu1VFNbU_ZtxnKkvWBrAz1NH22J21HSXlqPlu5NHv1R47rG0g9Mdu-bjevZCPp2LP4EAAD__9_Tsoo) on social media.
## List: Ranking States by Cost of Living
The most affordable state in the U.S. is Utah, and the least affordable is New York, according to 2024 research by USA Today. [You can see the full rankings here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQRb8Gd7ZgYLEpKF7jbl-b0prAsCbCZmUma-3fR3Gd7urqSEc6H_fljrnk_fEfN_Kc6oKB84sW0yvowSymiz4RAemOvBoVOJicG7vVU3CA2gZHWtlonZyU1hiVA-XsSFOXPUgw0iiQ7mYNDGqaMDhpnQk3QmWFkRQz12P4qnnnlVJ51xcdQ6hbV_zK_GxC_xMwC5jP8xy-G3KN-P4FBMxb3ektYF7rRumoO1_fK--PazTuMaV6RPws1DdGpiZg7g4fn2cuJTc7CiMfG-ZyKfnPAD8BAAD__wk1XLU) The study matched median income against the cost of living in each state, and it contrasted each state's cost of groceries, health care, gas, income tax, and home ownership. Considering only costs without comparing it to median income, Mississippi and West Virginia rank lowest at under $40,000 a year, and Hawaii is highest at over $70,000.
## 'Rosie the Riveters' Get Medal of Honor
Congress awarded the Congressional Gold Medal, its highest civilian honor, to the six million women who became [known as "Rosie the Riveters"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0EFrgzAUwPFPE2-R-BqNHjxsDDsoLaxbKetFUvPUN2JSkqDs24_tvPP_8ud3PfZHTZbcdNILtmn0vR4SrdhLXgAH2cvMtCMi4C7DtlAFNFA3jcrmtqzMoISpK6NroWpVohLDvVBK38UoTJNRCwKkkAWIpqwk5EVd66ERVSOHEnVRMSnQUPIh__Lk0oyj_fYrhnzwS2bbOaVHZLsnBh2Dbtu2fIv3tP5WBp3DLTLoUkBnyE0MuuAjIQ-0YsIQ-eydD2j4Rmnmg3dTwBjJO2355K3hCxptGXRwO7xfnsvz8bSvbi-wu34cXk9vn_vzhUGXhdY8NrKWYqWYFNOiyf79pX-1fgIAAP__RmFr2A) for their work keeping the home front running during World War II. The Gold Medal was accepted by [Mae Krier, 98, one of the original Rosies,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAUheGnwRsWXBMwA0Olyl2arh0tAtfOrbCJADnK21fu3Pk7w9H_fZ2vnhLt65ff0LUlzz40OnBWXAIHNasuugURcOjQSSPBwmit6e4uhsFakHIMIy5aiwCo4mUxEW9BK2M6ciBACSVB2ItW0Mtx9MEKbVW4oJeaKYGRWi79T6a93XFJr3xg6UPeuuTurT0qG94YTAwmfws7Pmu_5pMZTB_XUz7poH1lMJVcCXmhAxuWyv3Tl4iRh7yvBWulvPvE15wi3zD6xF_oz9nSsDCYasvlxYaJIhvepbBiNFKJrrj4eFJKVLVhSqybp_T3rv3b6jcAAP__QAJq2Q) in a ceremony at the Capitol Wednesday attended by dozens of the women who worked during the war as welders and mechanics helping to build ships, airplanes, and munitions. "_I launched one huge ship a week. I mean, imagine_!" said Lucille MacDonald, 98, who described herself as the "best welder in the entire shipyard." [The iconic World War II poster](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGuozAQRb_GdIPsicG4oNiGLttuiWbxALMCO7KdoPz9Kq96xWvvPcXR-XOf7ySHxO03nTzWNc20VHnxbMEgoJ1tE8aVGfnW8GicQY-D967ZR2Tv3F9aukV32pkuGLbDzZD2vSMOSyMjarTaGtS-6y22Zhho8br3dumYTK-s5iA15fZfklh3Xo93enFul3Q2x7jX-ijq9kvhpHC6rqstp9S9pCgUT9o-mMLp2wgSS5X6rJKiwimnIgxZXlw5w8a1wM4ZwpPBdfBmygVo_XwcA1wpHwEuyiACZtDe9dZZhVOTx_C45Dik9E5ZvZ0kx5dj_bHY_wAAAP__iv5uPQ) immortalizing the Rosies displays their motto: "We Can Do It!"

| **Dear Flyover Reader** , In yesterday's edition, we ran a story about National Public Radio losing America's trust. A senior editor at NPR wrote an essay describing the roots-deep bias in the organization, and his first-hand accounts of language committees, prescribed activism, and willful editorial blindness painted a bleak picture of a once-venerated American institution. It's not surprising. NPR's decline is in lockstep with the larger trend in American media. Like the "Newspeak" in George Orwell's _1984_ , the language used by many news organizations is meant to "diminish the range of thought." In other words, they have an agenda for your opinions: to make them match their own. This, my friends, is exactly why we started _The Flyover._ Americans don't need a morning memo telling them what to think. They just need the facts. We try our best to deliver exactly that. There's another key difference between _The Flyover_ and NPR; we don't get tax dollars. This plane runs on pure capitalism. If you value _The Flyover 's_ service of delivering news without the _Newspeak,_ would you help cover our costs? body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=59cfa045bfcc40ccb23438163c8b5ab4&_e=94yCE759E22juN18StoWmPAcGK8qiJoW04hAJZHAX-R4noLqns9MSw_POMbsS8g8u3hTwpdq3iEcy_BlYutJcT0PVlRQnqWd6pAOzRW86pPNgNZ3aGpRL3UddUdZoxV4iLg9AxGsmz7QDQ0DpXL9Mx74-dqLKkvYITHXlbTaAQ30AtIXHtyppFAXsFi61eVX-idusAEPL66ElD1XxUIg7KWJ3I46ZnpDv82QuLZCH10PTMYE4R6K9KigVEnh9sHuttNiwoWuvA9c6J05TGEMXFlbmwhob84IjwaCjbPDVo742CYKM5oJpzHKxmYreYrLd0ujtAJMgEPGJ99ZgqVGi08si3FPtMfy5bSpGybqfBspfwDdO6X-mzJu-xOR1EvZDwTl6qQf4aMa4lpPGEPuzQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=59cfa045bfcc40ccb23438163c8b5ab4&_e=94yCE759E22juN18StoWmPAcGK8qiJoW04hAJZHAX-R4noLqns9MSw_POMbsS8g8u3hTwpdq3iEcy_BlYutJcT0PVlRQnqWd6pAOzRW86pPNgNZ3aGpRL3UddUdZoxV4iLg9AxGsmz7QDQ0DpXL9Mx74-dqLKkvYITHXlbTaAQ30AtIXHtyppFAXsFi61eVX-idusAEPL66ElD1XxUIg7KWJ3I46ZnpDv82QuLZCH10PTMYE4R6K9KigVEnh9sHu9iGG6wzAsFT2soeRanasg7yo4ASDXfBM1dsKHEofiRxyyL-8P_Ck169OGwUg9BxYr_iedoPbYui6ZlHhwfkcjiWtYJymHMnA-F4IVrzFOSuXS0Vius3Trjx0u8Rb0XReNE4sx-sSTwz5MHKrfX9eqg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=59cfa045bfcc40ccb23438163c8b5ab4&_e=94yCE759E22juN18StoWmPAcGK8qiJoW04hAJZHAX-R4noLqns9MSw_POMbsS8g8u3hTwpdq3iEcy_BlYutJcT0PVlRQnqWd6pAOzRW86pPNgNZ3aGpRL3UddUdZoxV4iLg9AxGsmz7QDQ0DpXL9Mx74-dqLKkvYITHXlbTaAQ30AtIXHtyppFAXsFi61eVX-idusAEPL66ElD1XxUIg7KWJ3I46ZnpDv82QuLZCH10PTMYE4R6K9KigVEnh9sHuQUK2qjZhqIgV5dtDURySJus3FXJIeqtuuV1XbD7XEMAa4kF9x5ETyaidc8OjVv4mgMq3KrUDwC_2z1hMFBssDJ33Pb2AmN6cl4oG8--XAQT5ORFxAMa9IYf5LIRTRd9agDUVZskmruBIJ4AbjigiCA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f44def6619cf4bce99d7636911a5ef9a&_e=QMAi4K5ro-MdqmIxStGJfgG7W4US82skpDLoHjlpF1rx3y4Fdipb6ttLO388swfK0kIJ0ttQAds0lCiNsy6P0HQTXLXmtmdYUkpSPiDNO7fk-rE7WMOddKOCzMYLc-S9f5lFc_ZxHeWSP6oN1OKrTe4U7rfSAC2rC9QvSZSGhGwY7fmhCwf061Xkq4J06dPnAyc41BAevz67t52T2J_dr6gLNRJkeNtE3aRWKA560W-YCIwerdb4guUumThYyoVjsEJdYX0fsqmBIJHOhcnca_71_wwz-qout3JKr6nF5EnlY4Qlf3svzZYLYav8pbLMPmKn2JF6BF7gXjJAtMTUdbu_ySl9bICKqtr4U2FDLEBVt4Mah87j2FzB4URHn1r-uHKgBs1P519KkRTFDf7MHw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f44def6619cf4bce99d7636911a5ef9a&_e=QMAi4K5ro-MdqmIxStGJfgG7W4US82skpDLoHjlpF1rx3y4Fdipb6ttLO388swfK0kIJ0ttQAds0lCiNsy6P0HQTXLXmtmdYUkpSPiDNO7fk-rE7WMOddKOCzMYLc-S9f5lFc_ZxHeWSP6oN1OKrTe4U7rfSAC2rC9QvSZSGhGwY7fmhCwf061Xkq4J06dPnAyc41BAevz67t52T2J_dr6gLNRJkeNtE3aRWKA560W-YCIwerdb4guUumThYyoVjc7gd9DaZYNmk83Uun7L0IhQ83q2g4qJktBiWx3LP2z3z5WljpSWeMMhXU2libzizqPA4fekh9mhW7NkJ0T_oy-xXm7ZCMudpTql-Fr-wb6ku7wcxgEkSqR35-z9LyHVghcjplMTad2T5FNLiQiyqxA%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f44def6619cf4bce99d7636911a5ef9a&_e=QMAi4K5ro-MdqmIxStGJfgG7W4US82skpDLoHjlpF1rx3y4Fdipb6ttLO388swfK0kIJ0ttQAds0lCiNsy6P0HQTXLXmtmdYUkpSPiDNO7fk-rE7WMOddKOCzMYLc-S9f5lFc_ZxHeWSP6oN1OKrTe4U7rfSAC2rC9QvSZSGhGwY7fmhCwf061Xkq4J06dPnAyc41BAevz67t52T2J_dr6gLNRJkeNtE3aRWKA560W-YCIwerdb4guUumThYyoVjHM9dY6rWCUOQ-NijOxbe615pwafm0MERRupO2R-rpk2WLNr7dFyShrwlLG_kixUlXZPxUZLdPMfQ5SMDKcfKXQDUWYcIhi3DHdhgPKeA9Pqalmn36OfFoof0hjMoq95k6PVUqOk_BYmsIOkmGD8k3w%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

[In recent days, I've reached out to you—our community of supporters, allies, and friends united in a shared vision for a brighter future. Your response has been nothing short of inspiring. We now stand on the brink of reaching our weekly financial milestone, with just $4,286 needed before the clock strikes midnight.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmGRew-_FuD51f1e10dT3cyISeZ8G37D0WskD0J1wth65ZRk_tQWGs8jrnvoFkdXDnQvewNMe-H7bBmQdMiOdWmvXX57Y301dBeeXt8FHVfxk_dFEF8cSQewKB2U4crcRijzdgYIgH_96UnPzYMlwiTAGdeig7TzEukzakp26LtxeLOnG1DiM5s3oc62pvkxHCVxtigCjGgqKO7JxjwsoaCgwsXoJGwmKNvRtEZDsusawAAyywYlz1CTLjsKFg-UdZ9c_LyMSP0m3dLuvOaHVyJ6lMLTNtj7MDOgee5W4eoqaVPJZ0fTAipebE4vU32ItSkOy7uwaFKocw31DNxZnOMrVxhdWS-dTVk00WMQyotsJXP95Fh7WsslW6gR0jOZAc_TCw) The challenges we face are manifold: the scourge of pollution that threatens our natural heritage, the deep-seated systemic injustices that deny our fellow citizens their due rights, and the disparities that mar our educational system. subject: 🗳️ Persistence is Paying Off in Pennsylvania
body:
