---
| | Two important wins in the Keystone State reinforced a cornerstone principle: election administration must follow the law. With a recent ruling from the US Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit, RITE’s work in state and federal court means that Pennsylvanians can finally be confident that the law’s requirement that mail ballots must be properly dated will be enforced in all future elections. Separately, in Allegheny County, RITE thwarted a rogue County Executive who thought that she could run elections without public input or the approval of the county board of elections. In a settlement agreement, she conceded that she does not have the authority to control election administration in her county. Read about these cases and efforts in New York, Nevada, and Arizona in this update.

**The Latest from RITE**

**PENNSYLVANIA: The Third Circuit agrees with RITE, declaring that Pennsylvania can enforce its requirement to count only signed and dated ballots. **

Resolving the most contentious election law question from the 2022 Pennsylvania Senate race, Pennsylvania can now enforce its law that requires mail ballot envelopes to be signed and dated. The Third Circuit Court of Appeals agreed with RITE’s argument, which also prevailed in a separate case before the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. The ruling is a clear statement that state legislatures, not courts nor unelected bureaucrats, should make election laws. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=090294b37d&e=ea91f782ea))

**PENNSYLVANIA: Allegheny County Official Held Accountable Thanks to Pressure from RITE**

Allegheny County Executive Sara Innamorato has conceded that her unilateral attempt to mandate the use of drop boxes in elections was unlawful. The Allegheny County Court of Common Pleas approved a consent decree containing the admission to resolve a lawsuit RITE launched to enforce Pennsylvania law. According to Derek Lyons, President of RITE, “those who administer elections have a solemn obligation to follow the law rather than impose their partisan wish lists on their fellow citizens.” The County Board of Elections eventually held a hearing about whether to use drop boxes in upcoming elections, where they should be placed, and how they should be staffed and monitored. RITE will continue to monitor Innamorato’s management of county elections to ensure she remains within the boundaries set by the Pennsylvania state legislature. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=b97a965c0e&e=ea91f782ea))

**NEW YORK: RITE Continues to Push the Constitutional Questions About Mail Voting Law**

RITE-backed plaintiffs, members of the New York congressional delegation, and national, state and local political parties, are appealing a lower court order that failed to enforce constitutional limits on New York's mail-in voting law. The New York legislature enacted this law after a failed attempt to amend the New York Constitution to allow for no-excuse absentee voting. The appeal argues that the law violates the New York Constitution’s requirement of in-person voting, except for those unable to attend the polls due to travel, illness, or disability. It asks the court to end the unconstitutional power grab by a narrow majority in the state's legislature. Oral argument is scheduled for April 29 at 1 PM. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=d7d0f4de12&e=ea91f782ea))

**NEVADA: RITE Identifies Record Retention Irregularities in Clark County Elections**

RITE conducted a year-long audit of public records and found that Clark County, NV, is violating the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) by deleting records too soon regarding its practices for canceling ineligible voters. The investigation concluded that Clark County has a policy of deleting most of its election-related emails after six months, which violates federal and state laws requiring the county to keep these records for at least two years. RITE has notified Clark County of its violations and identified steps it must take to avoid litigation. Clark County has until the end of May to comply. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=5039fcd6ab&e=ea91f782ea))

**Las Vegas Review-Journal:[Exclusive: GOP-led nonprofit claims Clark County violated federal election law](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=3c510de650&e=ea91f782ea)**

**ARIZONA: RITE PAC Backs Effort to Reverse Fontes’ Unauthorized Changes to AZ Election Law**

The RNC and Arizona GOP, supported by RITE PAC, filed a lawsuit to prevent the implementation of Arizona's new Election Procedures Manual (EPM). The case is necessary because Secretary of State Adrian Fontes rewrote the manual without public oversight and in violation of Arizona laws, removing critical protections to prevent ineligible individuals from undermining Arizona's election integrity. RITE PAC's lawsuit asks the court to enjoin all or parts of the EPM, which include violating Arizona statutes such as allowing individuals to vote in Presidential primaries without providing proof of citizenship, limiting the public's right to review registration signatures, and eliminating the requirements to vote within assigned precincts. The case was filed with the Maricopa County Superior Court. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=04444180a3&e=ea91f782ea))

**DAILY CALLER** : RITE’s Riley Compton examined what is working to protect elections from the activist left, and Marshal Trigg points out the partisanship motivating the Biden administration's taxpayer-funded voter registration drive. Read his latest column at the Daily Caller News Foundation's “Big Tent Ideas” opinion section.

RITE has notified Clark County of its violations and identified steps it must take to avoid litigation. Clark County has until the end of May to comply. () Las Vegas Review-Journal: ARIZONA: RITE PAC Backs Effort to Reverse Fontes’ Unauthorized Changes to AZ Election Law The RNC and Arizona GOP, supported by RITE PAC, filed a lawsuit to prevent the implementation of Arizona's new Election Procedures Manual (EPM). The case is necessary because Secretary of State Adrian Fontes rewrote the manual without public oversight and in violation of Arizona laws, removing critical protections to prevent ineligible individuals from undermining Arizona's election integrity. RITE PAC's lawsuit asks the court to enjoin all or parts of the EPM, which include violating Arizona statutes such as allowing individuals to vote in Presidential primaries without providing proof of citizenship, limiting the public's right to review registration signatures, and eliminating the requirements to vote within assigned precincts. The case was filed with the Maricopa County Superior Court. () DAILY CALLER : RITE’s Riley Compton examined what is working to protect elections from the activist left, and Marshal Trigg points out the partisanship motivating the Biden administration's taxpayer-funded voter registration drive. Read his latest column at the Daily Caller News Foundation's “Big Tent Ideas” opinion section. | Abortion rights are on the frontline this year, and Democrats up and down the ballot are continuing to fight to protect Arizonans’ reproductive rights.

name: Lena Moffitt, Evergreen
subject: Just announced: $20B in climate investment
body:
Why the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund is a game-changer for climate and equity
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2468856/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi Friend,

Building our clean energy future equitably and justly means putting money and resources into the hands of communities that need it the most.

The **Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund (GGRF)** within the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) was created to do just that—and last week, the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) announced a game-changing **$20 billion in GGRF awards** to a selection of nonprofit green banks and community lenders.

That means **the largest grant program in EPA history is ready to fund community-led projects around the country.**

More than two-thirds of GGRF funding will go directly to low-income, BIPOC, Tribal, and rural communities, who have traditionally faced barriers in accessing the capital needed to invest in large-scale projects to cut pollution, lower energy bills, and build robust clean energy economies. |
---
[WHAT'S THE GGRF, AND WHY ARE WE SO EXCITED?](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2468857/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| We call the GGRF a "force multiplier program" because of how it taps into private capital. The combined power of public funding and private co-investment is estimated to 12x the initial funding and spur $250 billion in clean energy and climate investment in just 10 years.

**This moment is one we should all be so proud of.** I'm personally thrilled to hit this milestone, as Evergreen has been an advocate for the GGRF (then referred to as a green bank or clean energy accelerator) since 2020. Evergreen action-takers, like you, submitted comments to EPA to help shape its program design. And together with our partners across the climate movement, we offered guidance to ensure the program truly delivered on its vision of equity.

**This is a huge step forward in addressing environmental injustices** —and it's one more way President Biden’s IRA is delivering for all Americans and propelling our clean energy transition.

Onward, |
---
| | | [ ](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2468858/87SdQ4wZ)
---
### Lena Moffitt
Executive Director

body:
Crouch says she will never leave behind Indiana's most vulnerable; renews call for audit of Family and Social Services Administration

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/crouchforindiana/clay-county-treasurer-jennifer-flater-endorses-suzanne-crouch-for-governor-12690613?e=8f9fef7158)

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
April 12, 2024

MEDIA CONTACT
Robert Vane
robert@veteranstrategies.com
Gubernatorial Candidate Suzanne Crouch Releases New Broadcast Campaign Ad:
“We Fight for Them”

Crouch says she will never leave behind Indiana’s most vulnerable; renews call for audit of Family and Social Services Administration
https://vimeo.com/933522423?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=829dfbb3a0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Indianapolis, IND —Republican gubernatorial candidate Suzanne Crouch today made clear her commitment to support Indiana’s most vulnerable and commission an outside audit of one of our state’s biggest agencies.

Crouch’s new campaign ad, “We Fight for Them (https://vimeo.com/933522423?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=829dfbb3a0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ” details her commitment to helping Hoosiers who are caregivers for their severely disabled children and who the bureaucracy wants to leave behind.

“FSSA made an inexcusable accounting error and wants Hoosier families to pay the price,” said Crouch. “This is unacceptable and will not happen in a Crouch Administration. We're going to be judged by how we care for the most vulnerable among us. Let us be judged in a positive way."

In December 2023 the state's Medicaid office discovered a forecasting error (https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/2024/01/29/lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-urges-pause-on-cutting-paid-family-caregivers/72397462007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=829dfbb3a0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) resulting in an almost $1 billion shortfall; to close this gap FSSA proposed several budget cuts. As part of these cuts, FSSA announced in January 2024 that it would no longer pay parents or spouses for caring for elderly or disabled loved ones, including children with severe disabilities and complex medical conditions.

Crouch jumped to the defense of these families and said FSSA’s decision was “unconscionable (https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/2024/01/29/lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-urges-pause-on-cutting-paid-family-caregivers/72397462007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=829dfbb3a0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .”

“We don’t turn our backs on our most vulnerable—we fight for them,” said Crouch.

This six-figure ad buy will run on broadcast TV statewide.

“Suzanne is a dedicated champion of our most vulnerable Hoosiers. I️ know she will continue to be so as governor, and that’s why she has my unreserved endorsement,” said Cecilia Coble, Fishers City Council President

Since its launch in December 2022, the Crouch for Governor campaign has received public pledges of support (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=829dfbb3a0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) from more than 160 grassroots leaders—including more than 20 past or present county sheriffs.

Additionally, Suzanne is the only candidate in the race for governor who has committed to eliminating Indiana’s individual income tax. As a result of her plan, the average Hoosier would save $2,000 annually in state taxes.

You can learn more about “Axe the Tax” here (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=829dfbb3a0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .
###
To learn more about how Suzanne is the only conservative Republican fighting China, proposing an elimination of Indiana’s individual income tax, and casting the key votes to protect our most vulnerable Hoosiers, please visit her web site at www.crouchforindiana.com.

============================================================
Paid for by Friends of Suzanne Crouch

The current administration’s weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.

| _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=1fb458ffa3964d35980def28738014c4&_t=vG9XE7Ogu6ZUBg3dbcIk6QMiWb95EG7ZLLB4Zo5nVPKHZEZwZkZyVvQo_NGN54JjBlX5uTtwZBt6Tnl7uPTfILIGX92xDYOfUCVkCCRMYOc%3D)_

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1fb458ffa3964d35980def28738014c4&_e=LnDfTHMGMkw6B4Mc86txKlj_bOtRWQk_vseLZ64s84IGdvkKNVHsNtWyDovFBSV77Yv6EHngnSuRgFcLiujaVV5G3QweHB0gV_7nz5OHua62EjNVLfTJL0snwp8lSSjtbNzhCvgQ307BbpDwpzkTjkdjQF2ERNgm1Hn-j_ghYnGZXO0QQTott51CIqQP74mtvxltJLW3YD9gHpDpJApDZjwHmoN5OW7V3jABv2CTQgq6uWiGnEsyyvazrFrDpQWHNljeoj9Z6-MG8kciMWDaV2dhaEz3ZyVIyOLPYulZ726rwMXiKJgZEwa3qQTnA94fdtFQQ-9YuA59jIF09kqXtBsqeaF1a9wN6kqwxxLS5iOGtTsTZvgisOFtktt4bWEg)

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **[National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1fb458ffa3964d35980def28738014c4&_e=LnDfTHMGMkw6B4Mc86txKlj_bOtRWQk_vseLZ64s84IGdvkKNVHsNtWyDovFBSV77Yv6EHngnSuRgFcLiujaVV5G3QweHB0gV_7nz5OHua62EjNVLfTJL0snwp8lSSjtbNzhCvgQ307BbpDwpzkTjkdjQF2ERNgm1Hn-j_ghYnGZXO0QQTott51CIqQP74mtvxltJLW3YD9gHpDpJApDZjwHmoN5OW7V3jABv2CTQgp3pPeXKTvbimMDHQfOLaj4EiUptXe9fCdaNiZl-PQsXLgzvL7OLaEN4soOohNQp1CRAypOn7JeqFOMqInm-mQNepa-KBqRmg4Sm2T_LVqvgDOXbm5Gm1igv7i_Wroivpyy6W5vVfqdS31ywnEy5myD).**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the [Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1fb458ffa3964d35980def28738014c4&_e=LnDfTHMGMkw6B4Mc86txKlj_bOtRWQk_vseLZ64s84IGdvkKNVHsNtWyDovFBSV77Yv6EHngnSuRgFcLiujaVV5G3QweHB0gV_7nz5OHua62EjNVLfTJL0snwp8lSSjtbNzhCvgQ307BbpDwpzkTjkdjQF2ERNgm1Hn-j_ghYnGZXO0QQTott51CIqQP74mtvxltJLW3YD9gHpDpJApDZjwHmoN5OW7V3jABv2CTQgqLZ_ca289nwHClzD4ebG1pXYon33zjUhKFj20Y4CvIKOaYJ3VB8TEun_4EKpuk8Q4a_b2oMdx82faYkZpweiOrqU8g0fC23klFCDXY4bkYTwrs1i6LlrgiAcWkw_hnHzxr9F_aFnYM-kRiJs8vXuPM).**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1fb458ffa3964d35980def28738014c4&_e=LnDfTHMGMkw6B4Mc86txKlj_bOtRWQk_vseLZ64s84IGdvkKNVHsNtWyDovFBSV77Yv6EHngnSuRgFcLiujaVV5G3QweHB0gV_7nz5OHua62EjNVLfTJL0snwp8lSSjtbNzhCvgQ307BbpDwpzkTjkdjQF2ERNgm1Hn-j_ghYnGZXO0QQTott51CIqQP74mtvxltJLW3YD9gHpDpJApDZjwHmoN5OW7V3jABv2CTQgpWpIfKndNEGtbCjbv0D4ZizQnzmMKlO2okfV8xhuQwvxd9vlOjnxzPsQx7ZpLr7aI_pZNynKm6TDmIFBZUSxKjd_EiR5yH4tK9sbbA0Zpog8eARjIGenuGxTpY-xYY3vvn0Lr7trvOzFCtc7HRgDM6)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our [**National Survey on the Department of Justice**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1fb458ffa3964d35980def28738014c4&_e=LnDfTHMGMkw6B4Mc86txKlj_bOtRWQk_vseLZ64s84IGdvkKNVHsNtWyDovFBSV77Yv6EHngnSuRgFcLiujaVV5G3QweHB0gV_7nz5OHua62EjNVLfTJL0snwp8lSSjtbNzhCvgQ307BbpDwpzkTjkdjQF2ERNgm1Hn-j_ghYnGZXO0QQTott51CIqQP74mtvxltJLW3YD9gHpDpJApDZjwHmoN5OW7V3jABv2CTQgrHzt3ZLw5Om1pomfISuwNJz0u5xDfOAmbJGFRyG8BgLXTQpQODZ3NMwhJC0gjrhrsytwkpQTHdsZ5-jMaZozRSb89OgSXFDPyYQDBbaUTPfqzn8I3ZeN9Nw1eGPwhUhrf2LTAhzCvg622PBIbK5Hww) and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1fb458ffa3964d35980def28738014c4&_e=LnDfTHMGMkw6B4Mc86txKlj_bOtRWQk_vseLZ64s84IGdvkKNVHsNtWyDovFBSV77Yv6EHngnSuRgFcLiujaVV5G3QweHB0gV_7nz5OHua62EjNVLfTJL0snwp8lSSjtbNzhCvgQ307BbpDwpzkTjkdjQF2ERNgm1Hn-j_ghYnGZXO0QQTott51CIqQP74mtvxltJLW3YD9gHpDpJApDZjwHmoN5OW7V3jABv2CTQgo3_m1t2Zx1PKo4Tu9UsGPIOJztY1FNAF7KybBsBCMo2EuprRYPVR9i33iEfLiaFzalfvpINKp9mFlCAgLGlN4ajTX0MuX0-k3BFG4MoYOL4J643aw96XCmX1sgbJITSKAQye8fWeBI-2RtVek8puVZ)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

[ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=573eaecf6e8c4df68d3436341674041f&_e=pWWxKS8P1PkK-qKwr-MZCHFohsX4p6tS0Uj_Z_BVKWiDlgc72eV98E1XaIZQENzT54nkiKeBRy8mo4wHunLpLWDIVxX3nsk1jX__7736vl7LwbMKuoSxsQtOpdz9qYfX_ZM-81BsbcihKylg6dHo4Aa-G-Dpj3c9uyub3BnxB0TUY3ePJbC7NSAsiv3w3eYW1ULFMQ9eWLVSj3MTkw43ckTV_OImi4iQLv3lO_YRfg8tYboWz93rPmhtNuRIajWhsU3XOPZD5q010QXk43jAFblONJ72w3hEOi0f6sP4O4wXXAwSrmR5fcrLNneRikEJsnr56jviDBcm4BEV21pjFfW7adWuX3gAotbizjmJ7eVm8GIpj6zGDVsuCqB0Ou4pJVrQCC5xU3hTepRpHWN-uHD9BIdK7gOjjDDn49zohqE%3D)

Here’s the deal, Peter.

**Dear President Biden,

I’m so thankful for everything you’ve done as President!

**Despite MAGA turmoil, over the last three years, you’ve fought TIRELESSLY for the American people — defending abortion rights, confirming an incredible Supreme Court Justice, saving Social Security from GOP cuts, and creating millions of jobs for the people.**

I know standing up to MAGA Republican attacks isn’t easy, but it is always the right thing to do.

So as the 2024 race kicks into high gear, I wanted to show my support and thank you for being such an amazing leader for our country!

1. Our Backbone: Precinct Committee Officers
2. The Unacceptable Cost For Dems: Far-Right Rural Reign
3. Local Determined Democrats Put MAGA In Check
4. For Political Groupies: Benton, Franklin and Tri-City Dems Meet and Greet

Next installment: Rural Americans United launches the largest non-governmental data analysis project in Central and Eastern Washington. This is big!
---
| | |
---
| | 1\. Our Backbone: Precinct Committee Officers
---
| | Precinct Committee Officers (PCOs) are the backbone of the Democratic Party and the democratic process. They serve two essential functions: 1\. They act as the eyes, ears, and advocates in their neighborhoods (precincts).2\. They participate in the election of party leadership. Currently, we are facing a crisis due to the lack of PCOs. It is estimated that only about 10% of all positions are filled, leaving us vulnerable during this critical election cycle.Please contact us or your local Democratic Party for more information. By providing your address, we can determine your precinct and inform you of the responsibilities and how to become a PCO. It is time to step up to the task and embrace our democratic process with dedication.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/2cOxGU3DT/c?w=SbsPsRvr0Ev7jT_swN4by42MKsYrPSq32JkaXHPMXKA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2EtZGVtb2NyYXRzLm9yZy9sb2NhbC9wY28vIiwiciI6ImNmZTI5ZjZkLWJiOGItNDU3Zi1hMTkzLTZmOGIxNGI0YjZlYiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | |
---
| | 2\. The Unacceptable Cost for Dems: far-Right Rural Reign
---
| | The inequity of our election process greatly and needlessly disenfranchises a vast number of people, primarily living in rural areas. Please note that I never write to diminish the great work that Democrats do; I am grateful for every effort. It is my intent to call out areas where the status quo is inequitable and unnecessary. Proving wrong and reversing the assumption within the Democratic party that rural America deserves less is my, and so many others, highest priority.Dismissal of rural America to focus on deep blue urban islands is a relatively new position for the Democratic Party. As recently as 1990, Democratic rural voters helped secure the majority of state houses ([Jeff Bloodworth/ Liberal Democrat](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/2cOxGU3DT/c?w=IS6sUq8PrRXILLYV4mI3flG3-OxZXBGoByjYQIbjlQw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGliZXJhbHBhdHJpb3QuY29tL3AvZGVtb2NyYXRzLXdoby1hcmUtc2hvd2luZy11cC1pbi1ydXJhbD8iLCJyIjoiMTUyMjJjZjgtNzllYS00ZjMwLTkwMjAtZjRhOThkOThhMjFlIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)). However, Democrats now only hold about one-third of state houses. Democratic presidential election campaigns began consciously avoiding rural America during Clinton's era, and by Obama's tenure, rural visits were exceedingly rare.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/2cOxGU3DT/c?w=s7TPNeNooudsclg96jk_eKLxYz-4huDbkAFoZ-HwPpA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93ZWIuZWR1Y2F0aW9uLndpc2MuZWR1L253aGlsbG1hbi93cC1jb250ZW50L3VwbG9hZHMvc2l0ZXMvMTYvMjAxNy8wMi9uY3NsXzE5NzgtMjAxNi5wbmciLCJyIjoiMmFkM2E1MzItZjRmYS00ZmNiLWJlZjctZTlmNTMzMTRiNTM1IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | Parties in Control of State Legislatures: Courtesy of [Nick Hillman Associate Professor UW-Madison](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/2cOxGU3DT/c?w=JNTkTYp2Dfr1W0KPH_HJ3W8eVsJ3D2wtrYtNXNedKmw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93ZWIuZWR1Y2F0aW9uLndpc2MuZWR1L253aGlsbG1hbi93cC1jb250ZW50L3VwbG9hZHMvc2l0ZXMvMTYvMjAxNy8wMi9uY3NsXzE5NzgtMjAxNi5wbmciLCJyIjoiYzM5MzZhZDAtYTc1OS00ZjA0LTg2YzEtMGZiODg3ZmM3ZDc1IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | Why has the Democratic Party stopped showing up? The truth is, I don't think anyone really knows, but there are many opinions. If you talk to the Democratic Party or Democratic campaigns, the answer is standard: not enough votes, not enough money, the cost is too high or our role is to win elections. However, this narrative is false and self-fulfilled by not showing up. By minimizing rural America, the Democratic Party has effectively handed over rural voters to the far-right, allowing them to wield significant political power.
So what is this cost that is too high? It is $1,200, that's it. The estimated cost to get a young or non-Black person of color to vote Democrat is $1,200 ([Politico/April 1, 2024](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/2cOxGU3DT/c?w=hQ3T_9B2lDxlYE9MUu9E-ju_dBtiIzqwnS5Xj4PM2JA.)). This number represents the worst-case scenario, where the Democratic Party is never present and probably never will be; they are just there to get the vote and leave. We must break free of the election-driven mindset and treat voters as people and not commodities; the cost would likely be far less and loyalty much stronger. Rural Americans United has estimated, based on our pro-Democratic messaging campaign, to be closer to $25 per person, reflecting a long-term strategy of education and trust-building.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/2cOxGU3DT/c?w=g6bHGPjS8Fre_-97QjfHxa_ymCF6lKwE4D9rs2iDsV4.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6ImNkZTQ3NTUwLWQ2MjItNGJmMC1hZmQzLTM1ZDE2MzEzYmJhNiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | The top four Democratic U.S. Senate candidates running in 2022 raised $200,000,000 more than their Republican opponents ([USA Facts](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/2cOxGU3DT/c?w=dPWvO0RZJ9dkdPwYqYAlMUxZSPJiLaprDQDDI25nsGI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6IjZhMzBiZGVhLTVkYWUtNDU0Zi05NmU0LTM3YTM4ZDY2OThmZCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)). This amount could fund sixty-seven senate races, 300 house races, or enable 166,667 young or people of color (POC) new voters to vote. If we continue to prioritize one race over another, we risk ignoring the millions of rural Americans living under MAGA rule, which is not a winning strategy. You may consider donating to Marcus Flowers, and rightfully so. However, your decision may be influenced by the perceived importance of removing Marjorie Taylor Greene from office. | | | Donald Trump appointed the judges who overturned _Roe v Wade_. He has supported a national ban on abortion, even in cases of rape and incest. He has even called for the imprisonment of women who have abortions. And yet, too many in the media seem obsessed with pretending Trump is somehow "reasonable" on the issue, and has "evolved" whenever he goes more than 10 minutes without saying something horrific. [**Enough is enough. Tell the media to stop pretending Trump is reasonable on abortion.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9b60618c-f9c9-4a72-bda3-0e60da052cd9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The media should report the truth, not bend over backwards to come up with a "both sides" false equivalency. Trump has repeatedly taken credit for overturning Roe, and now he needs to own the consequences. body:
This was a HUGE journey from when background checks failed in the Senate after Sandy Hook.
#

Friends -
As you know, Joe Biden took a huge step toward universal background checks yesterday, addressing a loophole in our laws that made it easier for people who shouldn't have guns to get them.
This was a HUGE journey from when background checks failed in the Senate after Sandy Hook.
Back then, talking about gun safety was thought to be a surefire election loser. So no one did it. And strong gun laws failed, even though members of Congress knew they would save lives.
But then we built a movement. As we grew, the NRA's influence waned. And what we have proved along the way is that states with stronger gun laws have lower firearm death rates.
Every single donation we received along the way made it possible for us to organize toward yesterday's outcome, but it also sent a signal that gun safety was a WINNING issue.
We did that. And because President Biden's actions yesterday will save lives, you should feel great about your support for our work.
But the fight is not done, and Gabby is asking you to help her take the next step forward. Because there's a critical election ahead and the gun lobby won't give up without a fight. So please:

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: [press@nancyforalaska.com](mailto:press@nancyforalaska.com)
**Anne Garland Young Endorses Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom** _Widow of Rep. Don Young States Dahlstrom is the Candidate to Continue Young’s Legacy_
**Anchorage, AK** \- Today, Anne Garland Young, the widow of Congressman Don Young, [announced](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=8959ee774c&e=a20d8ad2ed) her endorsement of Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom in her bid to represent Alaska in Congress. Rep. Don Young served as Alaska’s sole Congressman for 49 years, from 1973 to 2022.
“I am proud to endorse Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom for United States Congress. She is the only candidate my husband, Congressman Don Young, would be supporting,” stated Anne Garland Young. “She is an active, experienced, and competent leader in Alaska already, and I know that her integrity and proven representative skills will uniquely serve our state in Congress. Nancy is the person Alaska needs with the values Alaskans share. She will stand up for Alaska in every way, just as my husband did.”
Mrs. Young joins Governor Mike Dunleavy in endorsing Lt. Governor Dahlstrom as she seeks to build on Congressman Young’s incredible legacy. Dahlstrom also has the backing of Republican Leadership including Speaker Mike Johnson, Leader Steve Scalise, and Whip Tom Emmer, and Chairwoman Elise Stefanik.
“It is an absolute honor to receive the trust and support of Anne. I stepped up to run this campaign because I saw our current representative failing to live up to the standard and legacy Congressman Young set,” stated Lt. Governor Dahlstrom. “My promise to Alaska is that I will fight for our state with the same ferocity, passion, and conviction that Don Young did and I will never compromise Alaska's needs and values.”
Dahlstrom is running against incumbent Democrat Mary Peltola, who was elected in the special election after Congressman Young’s passing in 2022.

Republicans are trying to undo what we've delivered.

Peter,

It's Marcy Kaptur, I'm the Congresswoman representing OH-09 in Northern Ohio. My seat is among the most targeted in the country by Republicans. I'm reaching out to see if you can help me and my friend Shontel Brown who is also in a tough race. I know we'll win because we're delivering for the American people by making once-in-a-lifetime investments in our communities. Here's how:

* We're rebuilding our country through the **_Bipartisan Infrastructure Law_** , a massive, community-by-community investment in our roads, bridges, railways, drinking water systems, and more.
* And we made the biggest clean-energy investment in history when we passed the **_Inflation Reduction Act_** , which is already bringing good-paying green jobs to our communities and lowering energy costs for millions of families.

In every one of these bills, we fought hard to make sure that we were putting communities like ours first.

They've promised to repeal the IRA, reinstate tax breaks for billionaires and big corporations, and roll back Democratic policies that have lowered healthcare and prescription drug costs.

Here’s the deal, Peter.

I’m a straight shooter – always have been always will. You might not like what I have to say but I will _never_ sugarcoat the truth. _Trust me, we deal with that enough in Washington._

So, here’s the God-honest truth: **Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team.**

**We’ll lose the House, and truly, I don’t think we can handle a single day of total Democrat control in Washington.**

What Democrats want to do to America is clinically insane – _they want to change our foundations, to make our country unrecognizable. body:
One thing is for sure, friend: The once mighty NRA is on its last legs.
What once appeared to be an unstoppable force in American politics, the NRA has seen a mass exodus of over one million members, corruption charges, and millions of dollars in legal fees — meanwhile their overall revenue dropped 52% since 2016.
A former top NRA official told The New York Times: “The NRA is little more than a shell of itself.”
I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—but I also know that the gun lobby is scrambling to keep their influence in Congress by pouring money into the NRA’s replacements.
When I see these headlines, friend, I know our work is far from done.
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
With or without the NRA, as long as there are corrupt, purchased politicians in Congress, the gun lobby will buy their votes and strike down any chance we have for common sense gun reform.
But, if we elect a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action, we can stop the scourge of gun violence in America and block the gun lobby’s agenda.
Leaders We Deserve is already playing an integral role in electing the next generation of leaders to state legislatures across the country and we’re counting on your continued support so we can keep winning from now to Election Day.
So if you want to make an impactful difference in this year’s election, can you split a $10 contribution between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Last month, we announced our first six endorsed candidates for the 2024 election and are actively helping these campaigns reach as many voters as possible. Every dollar helps us support these grassroots campaigns where the difference between winning and losing could be as little as a few hundred votes.
Together, with your support, we can give the school shooting generation a voice in public office to pass the gun reform laws we need, end mass shootings, and counter the gun lobby’s agenda.
But our success depends on grassroots donors like you, chipping in what they can, when they can. So if you can, please chip in a split $10 donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Thank you for your consideration,
David Hogg

Here in Maryland and across the country, Black women face higher mortality rates during childbirth than their White and Hispanic counterparts. As a proud member of the Black Maternal Health Caucus, I’ve co-sponsored the reintroduction of the Momnibus Act, historic legislation to save moms’ lives and address every driver of maternal mortality. This November, Marylanders have a chance to vote 'YES' on the Reproductive Freedom Referendum, enshrining the right to abortion access and contraception in our State Constitution. The opportunity to codify abortion rights is critical as restrictions on access to reproductive care and an increase in cases of criminalization due to pregnancy loss continue to widen the gaps of adverse maternal and birth outcomes across the nation. Very few people believed we could win in 2022. All of the national pundits said it was a “Safe Republican” seat. So when the results started coming in on Election Night, the talking heads on cable news couldn’t believe their eyes.

Hello,
[**In a moment, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to my campaign for Congress.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82894473/466636453/1610638071?refcode=em20240412am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=0e311e27-e0f8-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTMxMWUyNy1lMGY4LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XxF8i7uLK-obNNHRHY_msxbNCYy-mzXtuXJMx8z9EU4=) **But before I do, please let me explain why your support now is so important if we’re going to win this critical House seat in November.**
Very few people believed we could defeat Lauren Boebert in 2022. All of the national pundits said it was a “Safe Republican” seat. So when the results started coming in on Election Night, the talking heads on cable news couldn’t believe their eyes.
The race went to a recount, and ultimately, after all the ballots were counted, I came just 546 votes short of defeating Boebert. _Ours was the closest race in the entire country._
We did it all with zero support from national Democrats while also being outspent by Boebert’s campaign and her allies.
How? By driving 24,000 miles in my red pickup truck to every corner of the district, showing up, meeting people where they were, and _listening_ to everyone. We put in the work, and people like you who volunteered, donated, made phone calls, etc... You made it all possible.
With Boebert now having running off scared, things are going to be harder and get even nastier. The Super PACs are going to try to smear me on every TV across the district.
**We can fight back against their lies and win this critical House seat, but I’m counting on your support now to do it. My team has set a goal of raising $100,000 before our mid-month fundraising deadline so we have the resources we need to win this critical House seat, but right now we're still short:**
[**If you’re able to, can I count on you to make a donation to my campaign right now – no amount is too small – to help us hit our goal, win this critical House seat, and finally replace Lauren Boebert in Congress with someone who will put a stop to the angertainment circus? I’m grateful for every dollar you can afford to chip in.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82894475/466636455/1610638071?refcode=em20240412am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=0e311e27-e0f8-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTMxMWUyNy1lMGY4LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XxF8i7uLK-obNNHRHY_msxbNCYy-mzXtuXJMx8z9EU4=)

Hello, = But before I do, please let me explain why your support now is so important if we’re going to win this critical House seat in November. | | You might've caught wind that I, along with [18 other Republicans](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3563ac7412de4b7b9ba8339537584898&_e=OtixplT9_2vSHWPQ4ldvIlCRrxV9oarcy_E0f58N33WY9nUGikCv_MZ3kLWXO8EpdK0SNmpQLm0ZcXFVscFOE2R5pnVY8vNOY2wG_xT0M2T65K7RiRFhHQ3gBr9BKsBoJAnDGMmWwyEWIDbYaml8ZcIKL9s-BiBjcA2Q6NMc_vIBp9Ylu7mArs-xyzhyxXH27-inEIFcjuqrNFFcoowpkKuIM_LaROZuzVuyMTISjz4khTa-ChAVgDq7QIaLrw51VXRjb2_XCeA4FVDpvG9YKdUSx8MM3ON3TdVWhq5NCbQ%3D), stood our ground in voting against a rule that would drag an old surveillance law back to the House floor for a vote. Why'd I do that? Because I won't tolerate the FBI rummaging through honest Americans' private affairs [without a warrant](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3563ac7412de4b7b9ba8339537584898&_e=OtixplT9_2vSHWPQ4ldvIpF0GThB0-thsKiP9bvwTXObMsNBmCXBg13I5Q6qGk-68727QpIjkcLxICwHP22Gjdum6Vd_DAfhNxSdK1uEWNdv_aEBu-fQsdvQqbtNAUs4o1BkRkISHfX2x9I8vmWYvJFHrgBswmw7cqNqfFyZ2Egapbkw4A1Un8daVVAlTr7U0IIUpbJtQjhjBbFKYFrGujRv4HSY7i5TP1KwE8URcIgEU-2AfKP4zWT8O5hGvPVS12rpk7li-BmQJH0Pvvh0Tg%3D%3D). For those of you not up to speed on [FISA](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3563ac7412de4b7b9ba8339537584898&_e=OtixplT9_2vSHWPQ4ldvIq2yVLBhp5H3L4Q7UAzcZhBz-P7WMuZ9VvGyPWPdXWNE2SZhCRtdKBrtKGx9ABRkM9GsKXqqkDGv-cbv9YiM0LyK6BeDn3s0lCoOBrXfq9nhA_MmPkdaJ-W_YIlbxCWL0-01gSBX6pToOYD9eOOaaYwPzsVGpfNicE1dc2OiYDNHU2LEGJd0sdWVYrQRU-7yiiTRYshnwC5R3XCIH4te0H504s5trZo1V0gBCVr8jskGOmTFWTgaqIyqdADBW4IwA87nVz-b7jiv_wngbmfSFNZtKLlPIb9SHQ77Jlx7PkssQEsOP4kbbaLuJAdyDnH9MQ%3D%3D), let me lay it out for you. Let’s say you have a roofer fixing up your house, but little did you know he’s not a citizen. The FBI can comb through his communication records, and if your number happens to pop up because you were texting or calling him—you’re now fair game for their snooping. Because of lax rules that have been [repeatedly broken](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3563ac7412de4b7b9ba8339537584898&_e=OtixplT9_2vSHWPQ4ldvIplh0NhQgXzh05SZWAfA8rZH-YU5NHbIwcrUWzk5F50wYvOVweTCeQnGH82GpoWjC5J5I6F6WHzetRLFgQ8nZ6Mgl7IPfF4mgFigGEmfOoB5BZ79Ii3vP6dfuTbU-JVUEATG6sac1XnPTaaMzBYMerOkfTbA2klMB48ku3g4VjDwNKXXpi-2Sx96AbMeM_D5souIbk30vX1__tV3Xj_GifGP6tDaO9QI5WyxfugemWdep2RylYVCjZ-fGmsP2QQ8DN7YNcKVjyKrriLNAfkONWc%3D), the FBI can conduct backdoor searches on the data it collects, even if it includes information about innocent everyday Americans. But don’t take my word for it; government reports show that the FBI has performed tens of thousands of backdoor searches that break their own rules. Victims caught in the crossfire include [members of Congress](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3563ac7412de4b7b9ba8339537584898&_e=OtixplT9_2vSHWPQ4ldvIlCRrxV9oarcy_E0f58N33Uhquq00n3x5Vd8-ulRNpH5UWMxBmiRqb5zHDcKLKs1xLZxZTvA7ku3YRWlv_FdUp17o-HM1sdvXuUCLMdH2vGhKHwboTGgldVKo-TrGkFSfxzRN5sc6-aNTDB-kG2C4G-kmx1h2MVlr7FVcDNV7PEBvjV9LdVAp4fFIeMP-vm70gYVlLIfG5fuDlG3bnRQEPYTQwPQklwnrSqp8-o4JXy3GIg7tRTWQY9M0MSsomSE_bPB0a2Uk2u8q_rIXxQathtSmRHwGZ4SMwhT6ZSUY_xB), [journalists](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3563ac7412de4b7b9ba8339537584898&_e=OtixplT9_2vSHWPQ4ldvIurvVjjUJCOdyrZL1C3Y3UFmKpGcWxdFLkbbnSZtn9oUD40BpOIwzAAzUX3ftQKDb9--L3wu3k0cSD4TF7FPawv9RryE_fVikAvKwGY5rD0U24SdZXq20qKc9GhRcgX_gJRrXR0V24wub7Xchsj5JwziE_mE7n0p0UjgrJwDnGTKVzlz9onc9YA6AjnirpbsXnKitgODEeu1dHBzR3c2dHT2u8nsnYseGDSO9CCdncc8kKAY4ECV4zpuImCYn22sFbdA4SeFzXw7g-Q26yqSKkmiqMo03QkiZKeFBVo6isWX), and even [19,000 donors](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3563ac7412de4b7b9ba8339537584898&_e=OtixplT9_2vSHWPQ4ldvIsb6VwSM_U7BmBfbaU-LxDNMEL-Hz8e_2C2TYG24Lrwi-YgXbbS_G9fZBaO_Uu69T4QKga7pApriMNCnNxN0SRSTpjZdcH9W-tFfz0IoQVlG6kuSfRc0i4oPU6ZXhlvdzbJT5e2j2_8OjzQ-_CpalyPBnRcldLepijJGjPxrZCrUKhiegvFoWLZeLlPAoL_bThkA1heN3V9yFeGgfXmtadWwuvX_wIdiIxDf8pmDmijzLlzu_063BUua05M9XYc0hsLZzLGmhoXKxpjb9oo5YGaBRc1lWTeTB2WwybjMmVcyFXiyRvS7R4AVmodo0VFcsQ%3D%3D) to a congressional campaign. If you ask me, we had no choice but to slam the brakes on this thing. It needs a major overhaul before we even think about giving it the green light again. _** **_ Peter,

| | **For Immediate Release** : April 12, 2024
**Press Contact** : Damon Drew
damon@emiliasykesforcongress.com
---
| **Emilia Sykes Reports Historic First Quarter**
**With over 1.6 million on hand, Congresswoman Sykes is poised to win reelection******
---
| AKRON, OH — Today, the Emilia Sykes For Congress campaign announced that it raised $815,942.72, the campaign’s strongest first quarter performance ever. The record breaking donations from across Northeast Ohio, and the country, highlight the growing coalition that is excited and activated to reelect Emilia Sykes.

“I am deeply grateful for the overwhelming support from everyone who has donated, volunteered, or stood by our campaign. We are building the kind of broad coalition that will carry us to victory in November. My number one priority has always been my constituents and I promise to continue my work in Congress fighting for good paying jobs, affordable healthcare, and reproductive freedom for all.”

Sykes is serving the second year of her first two-year term representing Ohio’s 13th Congressional District. Her top priority is making government work for her district. During her tenure, she has brought back more than $100 million in federal dollars to the district, including $1,050,000 to establish the Polymer Research, Development, Production Facility at the University of Akron; $963,000 for the Summit and Stark County Local Law Enforcement Assistance Program; and $4,116,279 to facilitate construction of a new, high level bridge between Cuyahoga Falls and Akron.

The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) just banned men who pretend to be women from competing in women’s sports.

| |

| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/wJmUp1ZiFkhkFs-1LnnFJA~~/AARclAA~/RgRn--s4P0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9hbmVkb3QubGliZXJ0eWNlbnRlci5vcmcvYTdjYTE5YTQtNjQ2Mi00ZDI1LWI5ZWYtZjY1ZTQwYzY2NmZlP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QkRHLVJFTiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVNJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDQxMl9CREdfQ0ZBTF9OQ0FBX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZhAFVxlmiHBLTlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

name: Max Engling
subject: Fwd: Door Knock with Max this Saturday! (And beyond!)
body:
Hey All - just wanted to forward an opportunity to volunteer tomorrow!
Shoot me a message if you're able to help - I would love to see you out
there!

Thank you!
Max Engling

MaxForIndiana.com

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Jacob Thifault <jacob@maxforindiana.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 11, 2024
Subject: Door Knock with Max this Saturday! (And beyond!)

Thank you for your willingness to support/volunteer for Max Engling as he
works to win on May 7th – now in the homestretch we need your help getting
the message out to voters!

Join us this Saturday as we canvas in Anderson and Daleville/Yorktown. It’s
a great time together and an opportunity to help get Max across the finish
line. Head over, get a shirt, and spread the message!

*Before you Knock*

*1. *RSVP with your first, last name, and shirt size (reply all to this
email) – anyone is welcome – bring a friend!

*2. *Download the *Numinar* App from the App Store.

*MORNING** Door Knocking (Anderson)*

*Date*: Saturday, April 13, 2024

*Meet-up Location*: Parkview Church of the Nazarene parking lot (911 S.
Rangeline Rd. Anderson, IN)

*Time*: *9:30AM - Donuts and Door Knocking *

o Meet up in the church parking lot

o Receive instructions, handouts, walk-list, and script

o Head out to doors – you’re free to knock through one or multiple
walk-lists (one list usually takes about 1.5-2 hours)

*AFTERNOON **Door Knocking (Daleville/Yorktown)*

*Date*: Saturday, April 3, 2024

*Meet-up Location*: Daleville Community Library parking lot (13601 W.
County Rd. 550 S. Daleville, IN)

*Time*: *1:30PM - Door Knocking*

- Meet up in the library parking lot
- Receive instructions, handouts, walk-list, and script
- Head out to doors – you’re free to knock through one or multiple
walk-lists (one list usually takes about 1.5-2 hours)

*Don't feel nervous!* We are only knocking the easiest
doors - Republicans that vote in every election. It is always a great time!

Reply-all that you are able to come out and we'll see you on Saturday!

*UPCOMING OPPORTUNITIES:*

- Saturday, April 20 @9:30am - door knocking in Noblesville
- Saturday, April 20 @1:30pm - door knocking in Cicero
- PHONE BANK! Dates to come - this can be done from anywhere!
- (Details to come on all events)

Sincerely,

Jacob Thifault

Political Director

(317) 420-1440

*https://maxforindiana.com/ <https://maxforindiana.com/>*

This Tuesday, a Democratic Senator [spoke with journalists](https://substack.com/redirect/66be7a59-2a9a-4648-90d2-d5668a56abfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the context of promoting his new book. His comments included several noteworthy reflections about foreign policy & diplomacy, as well as domestic politics and changes in the Biden administration.
One of his comments was particularly insightful, and predictably overlooked by journalists. In addition to its profound insight, it ultimately represented an institutional admission with constitutional implications.
[J]ournalists seized on Kaine's observation that Biden _knew he had been played_ by Netanyahu. That emphasis, after all, offers a compelling combination of politics and interpersonal drama.
But two other parts of Kaine's comments were frankly far more important.
### **What happened**
Senator Tim Kaine (D-VA) is most widely known for being [Hillary Clinton's running mate](https://substack.com/redirect/f08ab485-9462-4318-934c-0180518100bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when she ran for the White House in 2016. As a U.S. Senator occupying seats on both the Senate Foreign Relations and Armed Services committees, he has also played a prominent role in the foreign policy establishment for years.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae2bdb08-8089-43bc-af75-1ab0c8592e8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kaine recently published a book described by the publisher as a "captivating memoir of his travels through Virginia's wilderness blend[ing] adventure, reflection, and political insight." His goal to promote his book led him to [a fascinating interview with ](https://substack.com/redirect/66be7a59-2a9a-4648-90d2-d5668a56abfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[the Guardian](https://substack.com/redirect/66be7a59-2a9a-4648-90d2-d5668a56abfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ earlier this week.
### **What Senator Kaine said**
The bulk of Kaine's interview addressed the genocide in Gaza, and his assessment that President Biden may grow more assertive vis-a-vis Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu now that Biden has discovered the limits of his influence when trying to engage Netanyahu as a trusted ally.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=143524635&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQzNTI0NjM1LCJpYXQiOjE3MTI5Mzg0NTUsImV4cCI6MTcxNTUzMDQ1NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.tEJ1UY6r9Qrop5Q1J7zoQm_GRj8yqZmgLHRJqvWM5wU)
Kaine previously [challenged](https://substack.com/redirect/65ff28ed-5cbf-4de4-a73d-002439f78e3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Biden's recent decision to approve weapons transfers to Israel, arguing that it unconstitutionally cut Congress out of the process. As a senior Democrat with particular experience in the foreign policy establishment, he expounded on the nature of the relationship between Washington and Tel Aviv, saying that:
> "I do believe [that Biden] felt like that relationship and the true compassion that he had for Israel over his career would lead him to be listened to by the Israeli leadership. I think he is enormously frustrated that he's been trying to give advice, not like a foe would give it - 'I think this is better for you if you listen to me. I'm not just saying this is better for me; I'm saying this will be better for you."
Kaine went on to observe a series of changes that followed Biden's [recent shift last week](https://substack.com/redirect/915c4b60-0a23-42a6-a97c-67025cc6921e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> "They turned water back on in northern Gaza. They allow bakeries to start to operate again in Palestine. They announced they're pulling troops back in southern Gaza, and there's probably more that they're going to do, because I think he finally heard in Joe Biden's voice, 'Yeah, I'm a friend but you played me and I know you played me; that ain't going to happen any more."
Of course, journalists seized on Kaine's observation that Biden _knew he had been played_ by Netanyahu. That emphasis, after all, offers a compelling combination of politics and interpersonal drama.
But two other parts of Kaine's comments were frankly far more important.
### **Why it matters**
First, looking beyond Biden's relationship with Netanyahu, Kaine also observed how Israel's domestic security has grown increasingly perilous under Netanyahu's so-called "leadership." Kaine observed and predicted that:
> "Benjamin Netanyahu...has made Israel dramatically less safe during his long tenure as prime minister....
> He's going to end up being one of the most successful politicians and most destructive public servants to be on the world stage in the last quarter century, because he's successful if you measure it by maintaining his own position but, in terms of what he has done that has made Israel less safe and less secure, there's a real lesson there."
What might that lesson be? He went on to make it explicit--and we'll return to it in a moment.
But first, observe the stark observation with which Kaine began: "Benjamin Netanyahu...has made Israel dramatically less safe during his long tenure as prime minister...."
Much of the reporting about Gaza that preceded the October 7 attacks charitably presumed the national security bona fides of Netanyahu. But the [genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/1f0aff97-cdfe-4cdb-8e3d-1fc72caaf0bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Netanyahu has reprehensibly engineered in its wake exposed his commitment to Israel's national security as ultimately fraudulent. He represents what some observers have described as "muscular" foreign policy, bathed in the same kind of ignorant bravado that characterized the foreign policy of Presidents George W. Bush or Andrew Jackson.
Kaine's observation--that "strong" policies meant to ensure security can ultimately undermine it--has crucial implications for everything from foreign policy to the looming [scheduled expiration](https://substack.com/redirect/d42b2542-e562-40aa-9f37-4fa498231f47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a critical federal surveillance authority (about which I plan to write more soon).
### **Why it** _**really**_**matters**
Kaine's closing comment observed how the political success of a candidate or politician can sometimes come at the cost of voters and our communities. It has deep--and disturbing--implications.
> _"_[Netanyahu is] going to end up being one of the most successful politicians and most destructive public servants to be on the world stage in the last quarter century, because he's successful if you measure it by maintaining his own position but, in terms of what he has done that has made Israel less safe and less secure, there's a real lesson there. _You can be successful as a candidate and as a politician but end up being unsuccessful or even destructive as a public servant_." (emphasis added)
Kaine's comment was aimed at Netanyahu, but it could fairly be made towards any number of figures in Washington whose "public service" has helped diminish opportunities for working people and our families.
But because [the press is so co-opted](https://substack.com/redirect/1a517af2-c354-49cc-b41d-c2e86f8f75b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the two-party duopoly and its shared interests, few readers of American journalism would have any idea that the most successful politicians in Washington have also been among the most destructive.
_This newsletter is supported by readers, not advertisers. To stay informed,**sign up for a free subscription!** To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..SmjCVphDEEz2PPjTZDHUCeBuAKFshf7l3s9h5bbYX24?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=143524635)
That tension between the individual interests of politicians and their constituents is obvious with Republicans, who have proven shameless about denying basic rights to their constituents and serving the interests of Wall Street and their own careers. One could, however, make a [similar observation of corporate Democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/f0eb416b-0931-4663-8023-0843d672b084?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in light of their longstanding co-optation and [support for policies](https://substack.com/redirect/f0eb416b-0931-4663-8023-0843d672b084?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which were once exclusively objects of conservative support.
How many politicians in Washington have been successful politically while supporting policies that made America less prosperous, secure, and happy? I ran against [one of them](https://substack.com/redirect/3f3f0346-670e-4042-91b9-e8052598e91b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but I fear the answer includes the 435 members of the House of Representatives and 100 elected members of the U.S. Senate, not to mention thousands of state legislators across the country.
There's another layer, however, for which Kaine's admission carries important implications.
Our Republic is based on [representative democracy](https://substack.com/redirect/74dab295-92b9-42b6-8624-eca7b1336eac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In sharp contrast with a democracy defined by direct rule of the governed, democracy in America has always allowed privileged elites--chosen by elections--to make policy, oversee the executive branch, and interface with their colleagues on behalf of their constituents.
But that constitutional theory seems to have a hole in the bucket, one which Senator Tim Kaine pointed out to an international audience which seems to have largely overlooked it.
How often are the interests of politicians distinct from those of voters? Are they always opposed? Do they ever align?
Paid subscribers can read my answers to those final questions...

**BREAKING: FISA bill stopped from proceeding to House floor vote**
Friend,

This is a little bit of a longer email, but I hope you take a moment and read this in its entirety.

FISA authorities have been used to violate the law more than 278,000 times by the national security state, and there have yet to be any consequences for this illegal activity by our government. Therefore, I voted against the rule to bring the FISA Section 702 reauthorization bill to the House floor.

The reauthorization lacks essential reforms to protect Americans' Fourth Amendment rights, such as requiring the FBI to obtain a warrant before searching Americans’ data and a prohibition on the government purchasing Americans’ data from third-party data brokers.

Last year, in the House Judiciary Committee, I voted for a bipartisan bill that contained necessary reforms to protect Americans from unconstitutional searches. Unfortunately, Speaker Johnson has sided against holding a House vote on that bill and is instead trying to rush legislation drafted in a way that could expand authorities for the FBI to violate Americans’ right to privacy.

If Speaker Johnson is unwilling to fix FISA Section 702, we are left wondering what he is indeed willing to fix. We didn't fix the budget or the border. Now, the very authorities that we saw weaponized against President Trump and the American people are poised to get enhancements under this reauthorization rather than any of the reforms that are so desperately needed.

I have, and I will always continue to be, your conservative firewall in the House. Whether it’s expelling McCarthy as Speaker of the House or standing strong to protect Americans from warrantless searches - I WILL NEVER SURRENDER.

The vote was important, and the outcome was critical to our mission of keeping **Americans FIRST.** [**With your help today – the fight will go on.**](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=ebb952d7c48c4025ae1c3aa80e12c0b7&_e=GQ5cYT4MRYeiGMtzEO3vdOS1o5ksdeDHZnCSyQkAK3whOu7101Cr181_xP3sTzv89YMETrSYavGxjK1VVsaoYmxK-nBK8an8A2a_kjzSOKYEMhKapqfpZkvtNt3d3z4z7GRvSzvSjqw7m8lFtCWtJulZ2uS-rCVN5PeRrE8Y9VOlgIeQIEInH6roCscCe5qozs456a3oYNZ7WDCFSOtdO_M2CbUrytLdoDPS3R5i_ct_dn2XylU57PxSnFTM0Oc3AKwUr7Y3UbhWDq9mcb7HDOBYSsuGxMC1loBuTrmgv1n5YZs-J4O4KKNMqoAWz1fRrz25-z5ynwNjPly2Qa4AZ_X5bFPee3s7KD74NPN2X0fpnDWk5T77cEX5K2VthNFx)

clean_body: | BREAKING: FISA bill stopped from proceeding to House floor vote Friend, This is a little bit of a longer email, but I hope you take a moment and read this in its entirety. FISA authorities have been used to violate the law more than 278,000 times by the national security state, and there have yet to be any consequences for this illegal activity by our government. Therefore, I voted against the rule to bring the FISA Section 702 reauthorization bill to the House floor. The reauthorization lacks essential reforms to protect Americans' Fourth Amendment rights, such as requiring the FBI to obtain a warrant before searching Americans’ data and a prohibition on the government purchasing Americans’ data from third-party data brokers. Last year, in the House Judiciary Committee, I voted for a bipartisan bill that contained necessary reforms to protect Americans from unconstitutional searches. Unfortunately, Speaker Johnson has sided against holding a House vote on that bill and is instead trying to rush legislation drafted in a way that could expand authorities for the FBI to violate Americans’ right to privacy. If Speaker Johnson is unwilling to fix FISA Section 702, we are left wondering what he is indeed willing to fix. We didn't fix the budget or the border. Now, the very authorities that we saw weaponized against President Trump and the American people are poised to get enhancements under this reauthorization rather than any of the reforms that are so desperately needed. I have, and I will always continue to be, your conservative firewall in the House. Whether it’s expelling McCarthy as Speaker of the House or standing strong to protect Americans from warrantless searches - I WILL NEVER SURRENDER. The vote was important, and the outcome was critical to our mission of keeping Americans FIRST. | I don’t always do what’s most popular – I do what’s RIGHT. | | The Senate, once hailed as the "world's greatest deliberative body," is a dysfunctional shadow of its original self. **What's the biggest source of that dysfunction? Mitch McConnell's abuse of the "no-effort" filibuster to paralyze the Senate and protect the interests of the privileged.** This inflicts damage on our ability to deliver for Americans in two critical ways. First, McConnell deploys the no-effort filibuster to waste the Senate's time. A non-controversial nomination takes a week. And a broadly supported policy bill takes two weeks (one week to get the bill to the floor and another to get to a final vote). Second, he wields the no-effort filibuster to stop bold progressive policies: Gun safety bills? Dead. Voting rights? Dead. Labor protections? Dead. Dark money reforms? Dead. Reproductive rights? Dead. Immigration reform? Dead. **Mitch McConnell has already gotten rid of the filibuster for his priorities: corporate power, stacking the courts, and tax cuts for the rich.** We need to reform it for our priorities: abortion rights, voting rights, protecting Social Security, and climate change. **To do that and fix the Senate, we need to hold and expand the Democratic Senate Majority.** As November's elections get closer and closer, we need to push even harder around reforming the filibuster and double down on our efforts to defend the Democratic Senate Majority. | | I am pleased to share with you that the AFL-CIO gave me a 100% rating for standing with working people in 2023. This rating is based on the votes we take in a given year and their impact on workers across the country. Here are some of the pieces of legislation that they highlighted as part of their inventory:
* **I voted against the CHOICE Arrangement Act:** This bill sought to relax rules on association health plans, letting employers offer plans without essential health benefits and insufficient reserves.
* **I voted against the Separation of Powers Restoration Act of 2023:** This bill threatened the separation of powers by restricting courts from deferring to agencies' expertise on interpreting laws and regulations. It would empower unelected judges to override agency decisions, potentially risking public health, safety, and financial security.
* **I voted against the REINS Act:** It would undermine federal agencies' ability to implement crucial rules safeguarding workers and the public. It would require prioritizing politics over scientific judgment.
* **I voted against the Limit, Save, Grow Act of 2023** : This bill proposed severe cuts of $144 billion to domestic spending, slashing vital programs by up to 22%. It would endanger Medicaid coverage for 10 million low-income Americans, eliminate food assistance for millions of families, and revoke debt relief for 40 million student borrowers. Additionally, funds for veterans' medical care, clean energy projects, COVID-19 vaccines, and public transit subsidies would be at risk.

Standing with unions like the AFL-CIO is about more than just politics for me. Doing right by working people means doing right by families like mine. **Growing up, my dad's strong union made a tangible difference in our household, just as unions do for countless families today.** I will always work to ensure the needs of working people are heard in Congress and our community. body:
Or what happened in Arizona could happen anywhere in America.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1154%2E62735%2EDs7EWU)
**“Arizona Reinstates 160-Year-Old Abortion Ban”**
_\- New York Times_
Peter —
Just this week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce an anti-abortion law from 1864 — long before Arizona was even a state and before women could vote — that outlaws abortion with **_no exceptions for rape or incest._**
First and foremost, I’m thinking of the women who will be most acutely affected by this ruling. I’m thinking of the logistical and financial hurdles they’ll have to overcome _just to receive the medical care they need,_ including out-of-state travel and accommodations. I’m thinking of the physical, emotional, and psychological harm that will come as a result of this disastrous decision.
**And just so we’re clear, this is more than a failure of Arizona’s judicial system — it’s a failure by our elected “leaders” in Washington, too.**
They had the chance to enshrine abortion access into federal law and failed to get the job done even after the Supreme Court ended nearly 50 years of reproductive freedom. Since then, red states — and now purple states like Arizona — have rolled out draconian anti-abortion laws almost _completely unchecked._
Enough is enough.
Everyone should have the right to make decisions about their own body with their doctor, partner, or faith leader, free of government interference. **As Michigan’s next senator, I’ll proudly cast the 51st vote to get rid of the Senate filibuster and finally enshrine abortion access into federal law.**
**[Make no mistake: This election will decide the future of abortion access in America — and Michigan could be the _deciding factor_ , Peter. clean_body: Or what happened in Arizona could happen anywhere in America. “Arizona Reinstates 160-Year-Old Abortion Ban” \- New York Times Peter — Just this week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce an anti-abortion law from 1864 — long before Arizona was even a state and before women could vote — that outlaws abortion with no exceptions for rape or incest. First and foremost, I’m thinking of the women who will be most acutely affected by this ruling. I’m thinking of the logistical and financial hurdles they’ll have to overcome just to receive the medical care they need, including out-of-state travel and accommodations. I’m thinking of the physical, emotional, and psychological harm that will come as a result of this disastrous decision. And just so we’re clear, this is more than a failure of Arizona’s judicial system — it’s a failure by our elected “leaders” in Washington, too. They had the chance to enshrine abortion access into federal law and failed to get the job done even after the Supreme Court ended nearly 50 years of reproductive freedom. Since then, red states — and now purple states like Arizona — have rolled out draconian anti-abortion laws almost completely unchecked. Enough is enough. Everyone should have the right to make decisions about their own body with their doctor, partner, or faith leader, free of government interference. As Michigan’s next senator, I’ll proudly cast the 51st vote to get rid of the Senate filibuster and finally enshrine abortion access into federal law. Dear Peter,
This week marks National Public Safety Telecommunicator’s Week, a time to honor the dedicated men and women who serve as the first point of contact in our moments of need. These unsung heroes of our community work tirelessly behind the scenes, ensuring help is on the way whenever we call.
I understand the critical role that public safety telecommunicators play in keeping Washington's 8th congressional district safe. Our campaign is committed to supporting initiatives that provide these professionals with the resources, training, and recognition they deserve.

In celebration of National Public Safety Telecommunicator’s Week, we're reaching out to ask for your support.

They all want to see Representative Charlie Conrad re-elected. Check his campaign donors and you’ll start to wonder why the far left is standing with Charlie Conrad.

([HB 2279](https://harbickfororegon.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ed96bc27b78bb6b7e94ca23a&id=67bd16a63f&e=3362c31595))

Thank you for your support!
Darin

Almost nobody in a nursing home is in a point to vote.” Hovde — the same man coming after social security benefits, supports raising the retirement age to 72, and proposed a $205 billion budget cut from Medicare — believes that senior citizens do not deserve the freedom to vote. This is outrageous. In Wisconsin and throughout the nation, Republicans have tried continuously to disenfranchise voters to their own benefit. It started with young people and communities of color and now it’s senior citizens. We cannot afford to have Eric Hovde representing Wisconsin in the Senate. He has no respect for Wisconsinites or our values. If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will be split between Tammy Baldwin and The Long Run immediately: Eric Hovde is out of touch and has no right to represent Wisconsin. Mandela

I'm sure you've heard—we're officially in a rematch for Texas' closest congressional district election.
My life has been about putting in hard, honest work for South Texas—from getting my GED, to community college, to taking on big corporations as an attorney on behalf of working families, and now pushing for bipartisan solutions in Congress.

For my opponent, she spends her days spreading conspiracy theories about the 2020 election, promoting cuts to Social Security and Medicare, and working to restrict access to basic healthcare for our communities.

Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

I'm fired up.
Today, right now, I am attending the Michigan Democratic Party's Rural Caucus's "Rural Summit".
It's a great opportunity to meet with people who share a common bond - we are rural, we believe in the power of democracy, and we're eager to change the tide in our communities.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Rural%20Caucus.png]
We have big news to share on Monday, and today 9&10 News checked in with us on the campaign trail.
Watch your local news next week as we announce the next phase of our campaign. This is crunch time, and to stay strong on the campaign trail, I need you to help us ramp up contributions. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
I need a big boost this weekend. Can you pitch in?
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Friends,
As a candidate for Congress, this conference is crucial for me to advocate for the issues that affect our district. I am focusing on how to empower rural America and ensure that it thrives in every aspect.
Universal healthcare, affordable housing, childcare, and education, clean energy, and a labor revolution are just some of the issues that we need to address.
I am proud to represent the First District here and fight for the needs and concerns of its residents. However, to keep our voice loud and strong, I need your continued support.
I have six events in the next three days, and to maintain that type of schedule, to keep this campaign thriving, your contributions help me maintain this unprecedented momentum.
As long as you're in my corner, I will tirelessly advocate for policies that make life more affordable for everyday hardworking people and create well-paying jobs that provide a decent standard of living.
If you can chip in tonight, it affords us the opportunity to connect with voters in every corner of the district.
Friends, it really makes a difference, no matter if it's $5, $50, or $500. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Let's get this done.
Very grateful.
Onward,
Bob
